none: PAS LIN-EBBADA: LIN-EBBADA: Roman nummus of the House of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constans, AD 333-350. Unknown mint. Reece Period 17. Obverse description: Right facing laureate, cuirrased bust. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN]S P F AVG. Reverse description: Victory walking left with wreath. Reverse inscription: Illegible. Diameter: 18.72 mm; Thickness: 1.29 mm; Weight: 1.84g
